svg.title: TextMAE overview
svg.desc: The input image is reduced to its 144 most informative patches, which a learned MAE codec compresses to 0.12 bits per pixel: an MAE (ViT) backbone fills in the dropped patches and a learned image compression (LIC) part produces the bitstream. A BLIP caption of the input costs 0.009 bits per pixel and guides an SDXL refiner that turns the decoded image into the final image.
svg.text: "there are two parrots that are standing next to each other"
